text_block_list.text:
Heading toward the Nikkei Sho,
one day Fenomeno was—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Un, deux, trois! Un, deux, trois!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Un, deux!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: What do you think you're doing!
And other times—
(RINGGGGGGG!!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
T-The fire alarm!?
Where's the fire coming from—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ......Teehee.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Wha, don't tell me you—!
(RINGGGGGGG!!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Nnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Don't set your alarm to such a confusing sound!!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...
...Where did the next Golshi-san go—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Is it just me...
or has Gold Ship-san's pranks leveled up...?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Right? It looks so exhausting for Fenomeno-san
having to deal with all that one by one...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me! Coming through!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A & B
text_block_list.text:
"Wah!?
Here, go right ahead!?"
(Thud!!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Eh, what!?
Fenomeno-san climbed the tree in an instant!?
And Golshi-san fell down!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume & Meno
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa~!?
SECURED-D-D-D-D-D-D!!
"CASE: Maintaining Public Order"

One week before the Nikkei Sho.
On this day, at Fenomeno's request,
we had gathered in the Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"'Today's main race! All Umamusume running
in the Hanshin Daishoten have entered the gates!'"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, she was by far
the overwhelming favorite today as well.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"In the lead is Gold Ship!
Gold Ship breaks away!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Gold Ship takes 1st place!
She's simply in a league of her own! A brilliant victory!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Shaking off the pressure of being the race favorite with an effortless stride! Even heading into the Senior Class, her unstoppable momentum continues!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"And now, heading straight to the winner's circle—
...Hm?"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"G-Gold Ship has started handing something out!
What is it?! The staff are even getting used to dealing with this!"

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
"‘It's likely takoyaki.
We also have intel that they won an octopus at an auction at the port this morning.’"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Golshi~! Look over here too!"
"Haha, you look totally relaxed~!" "Good luck next time too!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, Fenomeno!
Come rein this goofball in!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: If the unlawful thrives, then the model citizen cannot simply stand by.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss!
Please finalize my training for the Nikkei Sho!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Bring me prestige with an overwhelming first-place finish.

And now, Fenomeno's Senior Year race,
the Nikkei Sho, begins—
